structured.answer: I'd pick B, the one with the separate bars. Each number sits right on top of its own bar, so I could read it right to left: 18,000 ₪ of mine, plus 54,000 ₪ from the employer, plus 8,487 ₪ profit, minus 13,974 ₪ tax, leaves 66,513 ₪. Next to the 19,595 ₪ the account comes to, that told me straight away that joining is worth it.

stuck.where: Option A, the big stacked bar for קרן השתלמות
stuck.why: The numbers sit off to the left and thin lines connect them to coloured slices, so I kept looking back and forth to match them. The striped slice on top with −13,974 ₪ looked like it was still part of the bar, and I couldn't tell whether 66,513 ₪ counts it or not.

stuck.where: Option A, the striped slices on top of the tall bar
stuck.why: There's a teal-and-striped slice and a brown-and-striped slice. I guessed one is profit and the other is tax, but I wasn't sure which is which, because the colours are mixed together.
I wondered for a moment whether I should just go with what they recommend, but B made sense to me faster.
